title: analytics: `'*'` runs only under `count`, but a cube measure's or dimension's `sql` and a dataset measure's `field` admit it under any aggregate — a summed `'*'` answers 500 at the dataset door (split from #21000)
body:
Split from #21000 by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, answering the `pm:retriage` question `5952467081` with **B**. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`.

## Why a card of its own

#21000 retires three meaningless enum values. It is p3, with the full retirement kit. This is a **measured defect of class (a)**: an authoring shape the contract admits answers a server fault at a public door.
- A dataset measure that sums `'*'` answered **500 `DATABASE_ERROR`** at `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`, on both strategies. This is #21220's dev probe, recorded on #21000 in `5940326148`.
- Folding it into the retirement would make the defect wait on a p3 kit.

## The positions (read at `main`)

1. A cube **measure**'s `sql`, under any aggregate other than `count`.
2. A cube **dimension**'s `sql`.
3. A dataset **measure**'s `field` (PR #21240 narrowed it to a column reference, `'*'` included, under any aggregate), under any aggregate other than `count`.

A dataset dimension's `field` already refuses `'*'` (PR #21240), so it is the control.

## Direction

- `'*'` is admitted only where a `count` consumes it. Elsewhere it is refused at the authoring parse, naming the field and prescribing either `count` or a column. That is one cross-field rule per position, sharing **one** predicate. ⛔ No second spelling of the rule per position.
- The refinement is not expressible in the published JSON Schema, so it is ledgered as a dropped-refinement gap, the way the gate requires.
- `packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json`'s note, which points the count-only boundary at #21000, is re-pointed here.
- It is a narrowing of a published accept set: a BREAKING `minor`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. No producer is known to send such a shape. Census the repository's examples and objectui's mirror first.

## Pins

- Each position refuses its non-count `'*'` at parse.
- `count` over `'*'` is still admitted and still runs, on both strategies.
- The measured door cell answers 400, not 500.

## Serial

#21000 (the enum retirement) and #21365 (in flight, `AnalyticsQuerySchema`) edit the same `analytics.zod.ts`. Whichever lands later merges `main`.
